The patient states no prior episodes: 'No, no I haven't noticed that before.'
The patient confirms a history of osteoarthritis diagnosed by a GP: 'Yes. Yes, a few years ago... a GP.'
The patient states they are not on any medications: 'Uh, no.'
The patient mentions an allergy to peanuts: 'I'm allergic to, to peanuts.'
The patient denies any known drug allergies: 'Uh, no. Not that I know of.'

The patient confirms full range of motion: 'I can actually like move it normally.'

The doctor advises urgent review if symptoms worsen: 'if your, the elbow was to become very red, very painful... Then you need to get on the phone or get, have a video appointment.'
